notes.title: 《Anxiety Puppy》 Demo - Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is Anxiety Puppy Studio! 

After some preparation, our Demo is finally live!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3578660/_Demo/

This demo includes the first chapter of the game, which tells the story of the protagonist's life in the real world before entering the fantasy realm. Before being overwhelmed by anxiety, these small emotions existed in the ordinary moments of daily life.

If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to leave a comment or join our official player group. The demo also includes a survey link, and if you could take a moment to fill it out, it would greatly help our future development!

If you like the little puppy, please be sure to add it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3350190/_/

Finally, thank you all for your attention and support! We hope this game brings some comfort to you and that everyone can find their own little anxiety puppy in their heart.

For more updates, please follow us on social media! (There's a demo giveaway event on Xiaohongshu)
